testResults.name: streaming-recorder-and-audit-trail
testResults.result: 27 tests passed verifying the RunRecorder end-to-end against the acceptance criteria: referential link integrity across actions, orders, risk decisions, fills, and equity snapshots in a scripted run; bounded-memory streaming of one million events with bounded pending batches and tracemalloc peak below 64 MiB with full payloads; byte-identical reruns under the same seed and clock through the determinism manifest; and strategy Emitter protocol plus event-bus attachment integration. Artifacts carry per-artifact row counts and SHA-256 digests with a run digest, and read_artifact rejects schema drift

testResults.name: repository-quality-gates
commands: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff check src/harness tests/harness
testResults.result: Scoped Ruff and repository-wide ty checks passed after wave integration

limitations: The implementation landed in commit 6460ef8 as the package src/harness/results/recorder/; this wave verified it against all acceptance criteria rather than reimplementing, and the CLEO file list was reconciled to the package path
Process RSS bounding is asserted through bounded pending batches plus tracemalloc peak rather than direct RSS measurement
